## validateChainId() function

Validates that the viem client chain ID matches the expected chain ID. Throws [ChainIdMismatchError](./morpho-sdk.chainidmismatcherror.md) if they differ.

**Signature:**

```typescript
validateChainId: (clientChainId: number | undefined, expectedChainId: number) => void
```
